headline: Raid on Zepto dark store in Jaipur, 1550 dairy packets and expired food items destroyed | Jaipur Zepto Dark Store Raid 2026
summary: Rajasthan's Food Safety and Drug Control Department raided a Zepto dark store in Jaipur, destroying 1,550 dairy packets and expired food items.
why: Zepto is an Indian quick-commerce company delivering groceries from dark stores, and regulatory enforcement affects its operating compliance.
